lectures.title: ChatGPT With Coding Experience: Prefer Building Blocks

cues.en: Now, as you learned in the previous lectures
using ChatGPT without development experience is possible
and indeed does allow you to build programs
without knowing how to code.

and it might require multiple iterative steps
to get to the final result.

ChatGPT is more useful if you do have
this development experience,
if you do have programming knowledge,
because as a developer you can use ChatGPT
to boost your productivity, to write code faster
and to build applications faster.

to understand and to keep in mind when using ChatGPT
as a developer.
For example, I recommend that you don't use ChatGPT
to ask it for an entire application or an entire website
because as your applications and websites get more complex,
ChatGPT will struggle to give you the code
for the entire application in one step,

ChatGPT to generate and build individual building blocks
which you then manually combine to build the overall app.
Because since you are a developer,
you of course know how to combine these building blocks
and therefore then ChatGPT indeed can help you a lot
because it can speed up the development
of these individual building blocks.
